perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A source-derived prompt must preserve both components' frame placement, their material inter-region proximity/overlap/visibility relation, and the observed regional light-to-form and tone behavior without adding unowned semantic controls during final composition.
perceptual_contract.user_appeal: Keep the improved directional pose while making the foreground/background position and the lighting/shading distribution more faithful to the source.

invariants.statement: A material cross-component direction cannot stand in for either region's frame position or for independently material proximity, overlap, and surviving visibility.

When one coarse region contains materially different main plane, shadow zone, transition, or material mass, the Light/Form relation retains source-derived subregions and exact prompt anchors for both sides.

Every semantic span in an audited authored prompt is an exact owned generic, Color/Tone, or Light/Form control or a qualified emitted summary; section labels and punctuation are the only owner-free residue.
Runtime instructions contain no motivating body part, background fragment, direction, color, tone, coordinate, numeric threshold, or generator-specific workaround.

flexible_dimensions: the source-supported direction and actual region names
whether proximity, overlap, or visibility is material
whether Color/Tone is routed or the draft phrase is removed
generator response and delivered pixels pending a controlled post-change generation

mismatches.source_state: The foreground and printed background have both frame-relative placement and a close source-specific inter-region visibility and overlap relation.
mismatches.render_state: The broad directional relation remains recognizable, but foreground frame position and the nearby printed fragments change enough to alter the composition.

mismatches.axis: light-to-form, tone response, and dark-material separation
mismatches.source_state: Broad planes, localized shadows, a transition, and near-black material masses retain distinct spatial and tone behavior.
mismatches.render_state: The face and exposed surface shift warmer and more evenly lifted, while transition and dark-detail separation differ; the motivating prompt contains related tone and gradient prose outside its owned controls.

hypotheses.statement: A direction-only cross-component relation can remain literally satisfied after a generator materially changes separation, overlap, visibility, or either component's frame placement.
hypotheses.falsifier: Held-out direction-preserving displacement cases remain materially equivalent, or a closed placement contract cannot distinguish them from preserved variants.

hypotheses.statement: A single coarse foreground-versus-background light relation cannot reliably carry independently drifting plane, shadow-zone, transition, and dark-material results within the foreground.
hypotheses.falsifier: Held-out coarse-region fixtures preserve all material internal lighting relations without subregion ownership, or declared subregions fail to distinguish missing anchors.

hypotheses.statement: Checking that expected controls appear does not prove that final composition added no unowned generator-active tone, light, shadow, gradient, material, negative, or settings prose.
hypotheses.falsifier: A presence-only audit rejects the unchanged motivating extras, or the complete ownership audit cannot distinguish owned controls from one extra semantic clause.

intervention.general_rule: Use spatial-orientation/v6 to keep frame placement and cross-component relations distinct. Mark direction relations for degeneracy, close high-risk placement through both frame relations plus material proximity/overlap/visibility axes, and test direction-held drift. Split only source-material Light/Form subregions and retain their exact anchors. Finally, reject all semantic prompt residue outside owned controls or qualified summaries and route Color/Tone prose or remove it.
intervention.generalization_basis: The correction is parameterized by arbitrary source regions, relation axes, degeneracy checks, lighting roles, and exact owned spans. Source-neutral fixtures cover human and non-human spatial contracts, missing residual axes, unknown frame relations, missing light anchors, unowned tone/light clauses, and allowed structural punctuation. No motivating direction, color, anatomy, coordinate, or numeric value enters runtime policy.

decision.rationale: The known representation and authored-prompt gaps are now blocked by source-neutral structural and prompt-behavior checks, and the unchanged motivating bundle fails for the expected reasons. This supports a bounded claim that the skill now expresses and validates position and lighting ownership more precisely. No post-change prompt was independently authored by a clean-context run, no new image was generated, and no post-change pixels or user judgment were evaluated, so render fidelity and user-aesthetic improvement remain unscored.
